  "items": [
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Top-face compressive load distribution",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The top loading is described as distributed through a thin shell, but its spatial distribution and nodal weights are unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform normal traction over the entire top face, converted to consistent finite-element nodal loads.",
        "Equal downward forces at all top-face nodes.",
        "A centered downward force on an explicitly modeled loading shell, which spreads the force to the scaffold."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Results, Structures optimization, first paragraph; Fig. 6 right shows a single downward F arrow on the top shell without specifying the transmitted force distribution."
    },

      "entity": "Voxel extent of the top loading shell",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The shell is described only as thin; the fixed-solid voxel region, if any, used to represent it is unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "An external loading fixture with no fixed-solid shell voxels inside the unit-cube design domain.",
        "One complete top voxel layer held solid, with thickness 1/40 of the cube side.",
        "Two complete top voxel layers held solid, with thickness 2/40 of the cube side."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Results, Structures optimization, first paragraph specifies a 40 × 40 × 40 voxel domain and a thin shell at its top; Fig. 6 right provides no shell dimensions or passive-element definition."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Total compressive force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No numerical force magnitude or load normalization is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "A unit total resultant force distributed across the loaded nodes.",
        "A unit force at each loaded top-face node, giving a total resultant equal to the number of loaded nodes."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Results, Structures optimization specifies compression and distributed forces without numerical values; Fig. 6 right labels the force only as F. Mechanical stiffness states that the same loading setup is used for Fig. 7."
    }
  ]
